verdict.rationale: Orama's docs show documents being inserted incrementally into an existing database via `insert` and `insertMultiple`, without rebuilding it. Orama Cloud also lets frequently updated data live in its own data source, which hints at incremental refresh rather than a full reindex. Nothing in the pack covers updates or deletes, or says how quickly new documents become searchable. Missing for 10: documented update/remove APIs, explicit near-real-time visibility guarantees, Cloud incremental sync/upsert docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
